item.title: Weather: Himachal, Jammu & Kashmir to witness rain and hail; Delhi braces for showers
item.description: Weather conditions across North India are set to turn unstable due to multiple western disturbances, according to India Meteorological Department. Delhi is under a yellow alert for rain, lightning and strong winds. Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir and nearby regions may witness rain, hailstorms and snowfall, while fog and temperature fluctuations could affect travel and daily activities.
